name: current-auth-not-blocked
description: Guard against over-blocking: the posting only requires the candidate to be CURRENTLY authorized to work in the US — it does NOT refuse future sponsorship. The candidate is authorized on F1 OPT/EAD, so this must NOT trigger the no-sponsorship hard block and a strong skills match should score high (ADR 0067).
